description: A full life without the need to intervene and address every detail #selfpreservation #stewardship #intentionalliving
transcript: Most things will solve themselves without me intervening. The more that I live in a space of the present moments, the more I'm able to explore without judgment, the more that I'm able to allow myself to evolve. When I allow life to be what it is, it keeps me in a constant state of preparation. Preparation looks like building and taking small steps in this moment in order to be prepared for the gifts that are coming my way. There's nothing that I need to force and there's nothing that I need to rush. Time does a great job at being time and in turn I am learning to do a great job at being me by being a firm steward of this life.
